sections.overview:
A critical security vulnerability impacting the
 Funnel Builder
 plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild to
 inject malicious JavaScript code
 into WooCommerce checkout pages with the goal of stealing payment data. Details of the activity were
 published
 by Sansec this week.
sections.technical:
A critical security vulnerability impacting the
 Funnel Builder
 plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild to
 inject malicious JavaScript code
 into WooCommerce checkout pages with the goal of stealing payment data. The vulnerability currently does not have an official CVE identifier.
